notes.title: May 2025 Update
notes.notes:
Fixes & new stuff :

- Fixing robot disappearance if finishing the game on first launch
- Adding spacetime distorder music
- Preventing menu button sounds from cutting before completion
- Better jump responsiveness
- Fixing the inversion of gravity SAS when opened from outside
- Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Day One - Corridors Update
notes.notes:
Here is some of the early fixes we made for our new update !

- The sound of the thrusters now automatically starts when you go in 0G while pressing a moving key.
- The new enigma do not reset when you leave the center area.
- Invisible wall preventing you from doing what you want in the endgame.
- Comments fix in ultra high res.
- Fix of some collision on object and item and adding missing models.

notes.title: Corridors Update
notes.notes:

[list]

[*]Added various rooms in the central area, bringing life and credibility to the environment:
- Three new locations in the station's center
- Two additional mini-puzzles, offering clues to what's to come for the most attentive players.

notes.title: Massive Size Reduction !
notes.notes:
Here is a quick update to massively reduce the game's size ! As we were into making the game playable, we never took the time to reduce as much as possible the disk size. Now, it's done!

Also, we fixed some bugs :
- Losing input in end level
- Translation missing on tablets
- Soft locks in asteroid surface
- Reset of player's rotation when dropping an object

notes.title: Comments Update
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Day 5 - Comments Update![/b]

With this version, we add to the game an important feature we had almost done, the holo-compagnon now makes comments and add lore informations on its own! Fully translated English-French, of course.

Also,

- Fix of the slow down bug upon death.
- Adding a help sign in the first chamber for new players.
- Two doors prevent the player from skipping the central elevator enigma.
- Fix of the elevator calls not responding when the elevator arrive somewhere, as the hyperloop entrances.
- Better lock of the player position when reading stuff.

notes.title: Patch Day One
notes.notes:
Here's some adjusments on the first day of release!

- Missing translations on some 3d messages and HUD elements.
- Adding a barrier and clearer sign colors in the first hypersleep room.
- Cancel of jumping in elevators, waiting for a better solution.
- Adding test chambers schemas to the player's notes, as well as exit indications in each of them.

Another update should come in a few days, accompanied by a demo update to match the game's progress!
